user.title: Configure Sesame BLE
user.description: Enter the credentials for your Sesame lock or keypad. You can paste a shared QR Code URL (ssm://) from the official app to auto-populate the details, or configure manually.

discover_unregistered.title: Register New Device
discover_unregistered.description: Select the unregistered Sesame device nearby to automatically register and configure it. Make sure the device is in reset mode (press the reset button until the LED flashes).

import_qr.title: Import via QR Code
import_qr.description: Paste the shared ssm:// URL or upload a QR Code image from the official app to configure your Sesame device.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter the MAC Address, Secret Key, and Product Model of your Sesame device manually.

select_address.title: Select Device
select_address.description: Select the Bluetooth address of your Sesame device.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Discovery
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the discovered Sesame device? Please enter its Secret Key.

bluetooth_register_confirm.title: Register Discovered Device
bluetooth_register_confirm.description: We discovered an unregistered Sesame {model} ({mac}) nearby. Do you want to pair and register it automatically?

error.invalid_qr_code: Failed to parse QR code URL. Make sure it is a valid ssm:// URL.
error.invalid_secret_key: Invalid Secret Key format. It must be exactly 32 hex characters.
error.no_devices_found: No Sesame devices found nearby. Ensure it is powered on and in range.
error.no_unregistered_devices: No unregistered Sesame devices found nearby. Make sure the device is in reset mode (LED flashing) and try again.
error.device_not_found: The selected device was not found or has stopped advertising.
error.registration_failed: BLE registration handshake failed. Verify that the device is in reset mode and try again.

abort.not_sesame: Discovered device is not a supported Sesame device
abort.invalid_mfg_data: Invalid manufacturer data received from device
